# Drawer API

Reveal focused content from any viewport edge and dismiss it with a directional swipe.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

[Back to Drawer usage and examples](/components/drawer)

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the trigger or focused action. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift+Tab</kbd> | Move through controls while modal focus remains inside. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the drawer and restore focus when configured. |
| <kbd>Pointer swipe</kbd> | Drag the handle outward past the distance or velocity threshold to dismiss. |
